name: hotel-fees
description: Check US hotel room prices, resort fees and checkout totals against the FTC fee rule; identify mandatory fees, permitted exclusions and total-price prominence, then draft corrected displays. Use when you ask whether resort or cleaning fees belong in a room price, want a booking export checked, or need replacement search-result and checkout text. Works from pasted rates, fee conditions and readable exports, with supplied screenshots or layout details for prominence. Not for cancellation refunds, tax-rate determination, live booking searches or account changes.
